verdict.rationale: Context.dev is API-first: every functional capability (scrape, crawl, extract, screenshot, browser actions, monitor, brand/people/news lookups, batches) is documented as an API endpoint, plus CLI, SDKs and MCP server give multiple non-UI access paths, implying the UI is a thin wrapper. However, there's no explicit statement enumerating dashboard-only features (e.g., API key management, billing) and confirming they too are API-accessible, so parity isn't fully proven. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that all account/dashboard settings (billing, key restrictions, usage analytics) are also API-controllable, and independent verification that no UI-only feature exists.
